content:
alex: Quick follow-up from last night's slack spike -> eviction cascade. Need concrete owners for remediation items; keeping this thread as the single source of truth. Postmortem link: https://wiki/redwood/incidents/17649-capacity-drift.

jamie: I can take "A: quota rules" 15min meeting to align with billing. ETA Wed EOD. Ill open a PR for the kubequota change and attach tests.

sarah: Ill pick "B: scheduler tunables and canary". Need the profiling bundle and pod eviction logs to design thresholds. @mike please attach.

mike: Uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/17649/prof-logs.tar.gz. Quick excerpt:

```
[kubelet] eviction: pod=worker-42 reason=InsufficientGPU
backlog: 120 -> 95%ile 420ms
autoscaler: observed scale_up_delay=45s
```

tina: I'll own "C: short headroom ramp trial". Proposal: reserve +15% GPUs during nightly peak window for 2 weeks, then measure user latency + cost delta. ops-bot: make checklist.

ops-bot: Checklist created: https://hudson/tasks/3479. Weekly reminder set for 2026-03-30.

alex: Proposed schedule (confirm):
- A (quota adjustments)  owner=jamie  due=2026-03-25
- B (scheduler canary)  owner=sarah  due=2026-03-27
- C (headroom trial)  owner=tina  eval=2026-04-06

jamie: Also proposing alert rule: if pool_utilization > 85% for >5m -> notify #capacity-oncall + open transient ticket. Will include noise suppression window.

sarah: Scheduler changes I plan to stage: lower preemption aggressiveness, bump eviction threshold from 0.05 -> 0.08, and add a 30s preemption-throttle. Canary in cluster-canary-2 first, then prod roll.

mike: Observational pattern: short burst -> pod evictions -> autoscaler slow to scale -> user latency. Recommend adding instrumentation metrics: "burst_to_eviction_ms" and "eviction_to_scaleup_ms" so we alert on the _sequence_, not just utilization.

tina: Will add observability ticket to Q2 roadmap and scope a small Grafana dashboard.

alex: Owners confirmed? jamie/sarah/tina :thumbsup:

jamie: +1

sarah: :thumbsup:

tina: :shipit:

alex: Ill maintain the tracker and ping weekly. Tracker: https://wiki/redwood/capacity-drift/action-tracker. If blockers show up, tag @capacity-oncall here.

ops-bot: Weekly follow-up reminder: next ping 2026-03-24.

mike: I'll run a quick synthetic burst test tomorrow to vet the scheduler tweak on the canary cluster. Will post results here.

alex: thanks all. We'll close loop after canary metrics and headroom trial results.
